summary_for_children: An-Nas teaches seeking refuge in the Lord of mankind from the whisperer.
environment_concept: A lane of tall reeds that rustle and whisper in the wind, leading to a small lit stone shelter. The whisper is only the sound of reeds; no whisperer, jinn or person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Reed lane, a stone shelter with a lamp, a bench to sit and read.

areas.name: The Refuge Shelter
areas.description: A small stone shelter with a warm lamp where 114:1 is read.

areas.name: Whisper Lane
areas.description: A lane of tall reeds that rustle in the wind. Only reeds are shown; the whisperer is not pictured.

activities.name: Read the six
activities.description: Put the six ayahs of An-Nas in order.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the shelter and the reed lane to the ayah each comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Words of refuge
activities.description: Talk about saying these words when you feel afraid or unsure.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran
